English — Downforce (30 seconds)
No voiceover included; timed narration script.

0.30–2.80  Air can push a race car into the road.
3.40–4.40  But how?
7.20–12.50  As air moves around the car, its shape creates pressure differences.
13.40–18.30  The wings and underfloor help generate downforce.
19.50–24.50  That extra load can help the tires grip the road.
26.00–29.50  That's the science of downforce.
